name: Runta

modes.label: On-demand
modes.note: RAM allocation may autoscale. Fixed requested 8 GiB is used in the example; actual resized RAM changes charges.

plans.name: Prepaid
plans.note: Unknown limits are not promises of unlimited capacity.

caveats: Public list rates. Prepaid billing with $5 minimum manual top-up, no subscription. Paused/suspended/shut-down runtime retains billed disk. Memory auto scaling can change the billed allocation; do not confuse that with active CPU billing.

Features set to null were not verified. No sandbox was purchased or tested; feature/performance statements are documentation claims. Null maximums are unknown unless a cited note explicitly states unlimited.
A complete monthly bill requires known snapshot/egress/plan limits; do not silently treat missing ancillary charges as free.
SSH: docs overview lists an SSH gateway ("the stable SSH gateway host key") and attaching SSH keys to runtimes -> ssh true (verified 2026-09-28).

Desktop: runtimes expose a VNC desktop ("Enable the runtime VNC desktop"; Cloud Agent computer sessions = "runtime's desktop through VNC over WebSocket") -> desktop true. No bundled browser or computer-use (screenshot/mouse) API is documented: browser and computer_use stay null (unverified).
Snapshot/checkpoint storage and egress prices are not published (pricing page + checkpoints + egress docs re-checked 2026-09-28): snapshot_gib_month and egress_gib stay null (unknown, not free).
Free trial accounts share limits of 32 vCPU and 64 GiB memory (pricing page); paid-account limits unpublished.

fleet.verification: Free trial no card; adding payment method unlocks higher resources. Minimum prepaid top-up $5; automatic refills opt-in.
fleet.tiers: Free aggregate 32 vCPU and 64 GiB across runtimes; higher paid limits not numerically stated.
fleet.notes: At 4 vCPU/8 GiB this bounds trial at 8; no published 10/50/300/1,000 guaranteed paid fleet quota. Numeric instance/GPU count and manual increase route unknown.
